fabrication_notes: Select epoxy-filled and copper-capped POFV and use the 76-coordinate order CSV/map; 74 are source-flagged and two are CAM overrides at C6.1/D11.1.
Minimum 0.15 mm drilled through vias and 0.25 mm finished via diameter are present.
Board design DRC rules: 0.10 mm trace/space, 0.20 mm hole-to-copper, 0.20 mm hole-to-hole and edge-to-copper.
Published JLCPCB options support 8 layers, 1.6 mm, ENIG, 1 oz outer/0.5 oz inner copper, 0.15/0.25 mm minimum via and POFV; see official capability screen.
Do not infer dielectric spacing from the default KiCad stackup or the illustrative JLC08161H-3313 blog table; record the selected order stack and dielectric values.
Choose minimum via and POFV options, then verify the fabricator's production files against the coordinate map before panel release; resolve deviations through ECO.
impedance_note_ru: По решению заказчика EVT-плата остаётся без переразводки. Ширины и слои извлечены из нативной платы. Опорные слои являются кандидатами; непрерывность земли под каждой трассой и импеданс на выбранном стеке не подтверждены. Контроль импеданса и численные цели фабрике не заказываются. Вся партия 22 PCBA изготавливается без паузы; два изделия выбираются после изготовления для ВЧ-испытаний EVT. При отклонениях выполняется контроль партии и ECO.
impedance_note_en: By customer decision the EVT PCB remains as routed. Widths and layers were extracted from the native board. Reference layers are candidates; ground continuity and impedance on the selected stack are unverified. Controlled impedance and numerical targets are not ordered. The full lot of 22 PCBAs is made without a pause; two units are sampled afterward for EVT RF tests. Deviations require lot disposition and an ECO.
